familia.soon_text: Soon you'll be able to choose tours based on who is traveling, from grandparents to the youngest. Meanwhile, we're here on our main site.
familia.hero_text: Grandparents, parents, teens and kids on the same trip. We plan every tour so the pace, the altitude and the activities work for all of you.
familia.who_hint: Select everyone who's coming and we'll show the tours that suit you.
familia.who_filtering: Showing tours for the people traveling
familia.catalog_text: Each tour shows the minimum age and the ages it works best for. Select who's traveling to see only the tours that suit you.
familia.tours_text: Each tour shows the ages it works best for, so you can choose without guessing.
familia.tours_empty_title: We're preparing our first family tours
familia.tours_empty_text: Meanwhile, tell us who's traveling and we'll build an itinerary around your family.
familia.gen_text: On a family trip everyone needs something different. We plan for it from the start, not along the way.
familia.gen_kids_text: Short transfers, stops to eat and rest, and guides who tell the history through questions and legends.
familia.gen_teens_text: Hikes with a challenge, viewpoints for the photo and activities where they take part, not just tag along.
familia.gen_parents_text: Tickets, trains and transfers arranged, clear prices by age and one person who answers on WhatsApp.
familia.gen_grandparents_text: Time to adjust to the altitude, gentle walks, comfortable transport and options to rest while the others keep going.
familia.step_1_text: Select who's traveling and check the recommended ages and length.
familia.step_2_text: Adults, kids and their ages: that's how we adjust prices, schedules and stops.
familia.step_3_text: Pay online or by link and get everything you need for the trip.
familia.cta_text: Send us your dates and everyone's ages, grandparents included. We'll reply with options the same day.
familia.cta_whatsapp_message: Hi, we're traveling as a family and would like information about tours
familia.about_intro: Like In House is a Peruvian agency founded in 2018. With Like In House Family we bring together what we've learned welcoming multi-generation families to Cusco, Machu Picchu and the rest of Peru.
familia.about_story_title: Traveling as a family changes the trip
familia.about_story_1: When grandparents, parents and children travel together, the trip has to work for different ages and energy levels. That's why we build every family tour with room to spare: extra time to adjust to the altitude, comfortable stops and alternative plans if someone needs to rest.
familia.about_story_2: Our guides adapt Peru's history to whoever is listening: legends for the kids, context for the adults, at a pace everyone can follow.
familia.about_value_1_text: We're with you before, during and after the trip, on the channel you prefer.
familia.about_value_2_text: Adult and child prices with no surprises, and conditions explained simply.
familia.about_value_3_text: We work with local communities and suppliers, and follow the ESNNA child protection code.
familia.faq_page_text: If your question isn't here, message us and we'll answer the same day.
familia.faq_general_note: We don't have family-specific questions yet. These are the ones all our travelers ask.
familia.contact_text: Tell us your dates, destinations and who's traveling, with their ages. We'll send you a tailored proposal.
familia.contact_form_text: In the comments, include everyone's ages, including kids and older adults.
familia.contact_whatsapp_text: We answer questions and confirm availability right away.
familia.contact_hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
familia.footer_text: Trips across Peru for families of all ages, by Like In House.
